installAndBuild.installCache: Existing pnpm store, frozen offline install; no dependencies copied; not a cold network installation.

sourceOnlyRelease.supersedes: Immutable snapshot b exposed dependency/generated-file scanning by implicit Tailwind source discovery without Git metadata. Snapshot c uses explicit web/UI source boundaries and fingerprints .gitignore.
sourceOnlyRelease.limitation: Frozen installation reused the existing offline pnpm store; this is not a cold network installation. No dependencies or private configuration were copied. Distinct build IDs are expected; this does not prove byte-identical builds or deployment-host startup.

buildComparison.limitation: Semantic comparison covers exact toolchain, lock/migrations, compiled apps/packages inputs, route topology, asset count, worker/domain/CSS artifact bytes and contained host-native dependency bytes. Next.js build IDs and arbitrary generated JavaScript filenames/bytes are not required to match. This does not establish byte-identical builds, cross-platform compatibility, or production deployment readiness.

tailwindReproducibilityFinding.explanation: Both source trees contain the same .gitignore. The source-only snapshot has no .git metadata. Implicit scanning includes dependencies/generated files in that context; explicit src boundaries remove the dependency on Git ignore discovery.

restrictedPreflightRegression.negativeCases: Independent fresh-database grants: foreign column SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/REFERENCES and table TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER. Each grant revoked before the next case.
restrictedPreflightRegression.freshClusterMembershipRegression: The restored target alone receives journal_app -> journal_auth membership; SET ROLE succeeds, preflight rejects it, membership is revoked in finally and the full original snapshot matches before positive verification. Source/shared roles are untouched.
restrictedPreflightRegression.transportLimitation: Actual successful preflight uses explicit local plaintext exception. TLS URL-policy negative gates are tested; certificate-verified PostgreSQL transport is not exercised.

result.method: Quiesced isolated SQL custom-format dump and coordinated private local media, restored into a fresh PostgreSQL17 cluster with explicit role bootstrap
limitations: Tiny synthetic isolated fixture, not a production-scale RTO test.
Synthetic local trust/socket backup access; production backup-role/network/TLS authorization is not exercised.
No offsite transfer, encryption/key recovery, scheduled retention, physical backup or PITR is exercised.
No restore-to-public-deployment or end-user workspace export/import is implemented.

financialPreservation.evidence: Complete existing unit/property/UI and PostgreSQL correctness suites plus browser workflows passed. Recovery checks compare exact financial DTOs without field exclusions and all database-rendered table hashes before restored writes.
financialPreservation.limitation: The recovery fixture has three trades/six executions; it does not certify every financial workflow or production-scale recovery time.

limitations: No production host, actual public domain/proxy, certificate renewal or certificate-verified PostgreSQL session tested.

Source-only frozen installation uses the existing offline pnpm store; no cold-network or byte-identical cross-platform build claim.
